Hero.tagline: Start today on your way to becoming a professional beach volleyball athlete.
Hero.ballAlt: Beach volleyball — Club de Voley Playa
Hero.photoAlt: Juli Azaad digging in the sand

Why.quote: Trophies belong in a box: the best prize is what we learn, and sooner or later that has to be passed on.
Why.text: For years Juli has been turning this idea over: a virtual space where anyone can learn beach volleyball — technique, fitness and mindset — from the very basics to the details you only learn by competing. Today you can start becoming a professional player.

Bio.p1: At 13 I played my first beach volleyball tournament and never wanted to leave the sand. From that day my career split in two: indoor in winter, beach in summer.
Bio.firstTournamentAlt: Juli as a kid at their first beach volleyball tournament
Bio.p2: In 2011 the best and most awaited offer of my career arrived: I joined the Argentine national team. That's when the dreams of little Juli began to come true.
Bio.p3: In 2021 I achieved the big dream: I competed at the Tokyo Olympic Games.
Bio.tokyoAlt: Juli at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Village, representing the Argentine national team
Bio.cred4: Specialization in high-performance sports psychology — Barça Innovation Hub

s1.title: 1. Purpose of the program
p: The training programs and plans offered under the trade name Club de Voley Playa are exclusively for educational, informational and general physical conditioning purposes.

The content does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, treatment or personalized medical prescription. The exercises and recommendations do not replace the evaluation, supervision or instructions of a doctor, physical therapist, physiotherapist or other duly qualified health professional.

Before starting any program, especially if you have any medical condition, previous injury, symptoms, physical limitation or any other health-related concern, it is recommended that you consult a health professional and obtain the corresponding clearance to engage in physical activity.

s2.title: 2. Acceptance and assumption of risk
p: By purchasing, accessing or using any of the training programs, you acknowledge and accept that physical and sports activity involves inherent risks, even when the exercises are performed correctly.

These risks may include, among others, muscle injuries, tendinitis, sprains, strains, joint injuries, falls, fractures, aggravation of pre-existing injuries or conditions and, in exceptional cases, cardiovascular complications or other health problems.
By voluntarily participating in the program, you accept responsibility for performing the exercises according to your own abilities, physical limits and health conditions.

s3.title: 3. User responsibility
p: It is the user's responsibility to assess their own physical and health conditions before starting and while following the program.
The exercises must be performed following the indicated technique and adapting them, when necessary, to the individual level of fitness, experience and abilities.

If during any exercise you experience pain, dizziness, difficulty breathing, discomfort, weakness or other unusual symptoms, you must stop the activity immediately and, where appropriate, consult a health professional.

s4.title: 4. Limitation of liability
p: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Julian Azaad, as holder of the trade name Club de Voley Playa, will not be liable for injuries, damages or losses that may result from the use of the training programs, except in those cases where such liability cannot be legally excluded or limited.
The user acknowledges that the programs are provided as a general training tool and that results may vary significantly from one person to another.
Nothing in this clause is intended to exclude or limit any liability that, under applicable law, cannot be excluded or limited.

s5.title: 5. No substitute for professional advice
p: The information contained in the programs must not be used to diagnose, treat or prevent diseases, injuries or other medical conditions.
If you have doubts about your health, your ability to perform certain exercises or whether it is advisable to start a training program, you must first consult a qualified health professional.

s6.title: 6. Personal use and prohibition on distribution
p: The training programs purchased are for the buyer's personal, individual use.

It is prohibited to copy, reproduce, modify, publish, distribute, resell, share, assign or provide access to the program, in whole or in part, to third parties, except with the express written authorization of Julian Azaad.

s7.title: 7. Adaptations and modifications
p: The user acknowledges that each person has different levels of fitness, experience, mobility, strength and recovery capacity.

For this reason, it may be necessary to modify, reduce or suspend certain exercises or activities. Any adaptation must be made according to your own abilities and, where appropriate, with the guidance of a qualified professional.
Performing the exercises is the user's responsibility.

s8.title: 8. Results
p: The training programs do not guarantee specific results in performance, body composition, weight loss, muscle gain, strength, endurance or other goals.
Results depend on multiple individual factors, including, among others, initial fitness level, adherence to the program, diet, rest, sports background and individual characteristics.

s9.title: 9. Acceptance of the terms
p: By purchasing, accessing or using a Club de Voley Playa training program, you declare that you have read, understood and accepted these terms of use and that you are responsible for determining, with the appropriate professional advice, whether the program is suitable for you.
If you do not agree with these terms, you must refrain from using the program.

ataque.title: Attack
ataque.shortDescription: Approach, arms, ball contact and the mistakes that cost an amateur attacker the most.
ataque.longDescription: A complete walkthrough of the attack motion: approach, arm coordination, ball contact point and the most frequent mistakes that hold amateur attackers back. Includes specific tips to level up quickly.

mentalidad-deportiva.title: Mindset for beach volleyball
mentalidad-deportiva.shortDescription: Goals, training and match mindset, focus and discipline.
mentalidad-deportiva.longDescription: Work the mind as much as the body: the importance of goals, training and match mindset, focus in competition and the discipline to sustain the process.

planificacion.title: Planning for coaches
planificacion.shortDescription: Plan the technical, physical and mental aspects of a training session.
planificacion.longDescription: Designed for coaches: how to plan the technical, physical and mental aspects of a session, and how to build a complete plan to train and compete better.

defensa.title: Defense
defensa.shortDescription: All the club's exclusive information to improve your positioning and reading in defense.
defensa.longDescription: Improve your defense with all the club's exclusive information: positioning, reading the opponent's attack and the fine adjustments that make the difference on the sand.

bloqueo.title: Blocking
bloqueo.shortDescription: Individual blocking technique and reading the opponent's attack.
bloqueo.longDescription: Fundamentals of individual blocking in beach volleyball: positioning, timing and reading the opponent's attack to close the spaces well.

armado.title: Setting
armado.shortDescription: Setting fundamentals to master every attack tempo.
armado.longDescription: The fundamentals of setting on the sand: tempo management, placement variations and how to give your attacker clear options.

saque.title: Serve
saque.shortDescription: Serve technique and variations to pressure the opponent's reception.
saque.longDescription: Serve technique and its variations to pressure the opponent's reception from the very first contact of the point.

conceptos-generales.title: General concepts
conceptos-generales.shortDescription: The basics of beach volleyball before getting into the technique of each skill.
conceptos-generales.longDescription: The basics of beach volleyball: rules, game dynamics and the general concepts you need to understand before getting into the technique of each skill.

recepcion.title: Reception
recepcion.shortDescription: Positioning and serve reading for more consistent reception.
recepcion.longDescription: Positioning, serve reading and reception adjustments to arrive more consistently at the first contact.

analisis-tecnico-biomecanico.title: Technical-biomechanical analysis
analisis-tecnico-biomecanico.shortDescription: Detailed report of the technical movement, designed for coaches.
analisis-tecnico-biomecanico.longDescription: A detailed report of the technical movement from a biomechanics perspective, designed for coaches who want to understand the why behind each correction.

plan-de-movilidad-21-dias.title: Mobility plan — 21 days
plan-de-movilidad-21-dias.shortDescription: Progressive mobility routine to sustain training volume.
plan-de-movilidad-21-dias.longDescription: A progressive 21-day routine to gain and sustain the mobility demanded by the training volume on the sand.

guia-nutricional-para-torneos-y-entrenam.title: Nutrition guide for tournaments and training
guia-nutricional-para-torneos-y-entrenam.shortDescription: Eating guidelines to compete and train without dropping your level.
guia-nutricional-para-torneos-y-entrenam.longDescription: Practical eating guidelines to sustain your training level and arrive well at tournaments, without impossible-to-follow plans.

planificacion-de-entrenamientos-en-canch.title: Court training planning
planificacion-de-entrenamientos-en-canch.shortDescription: Court session structure ready to apply with your group.
planificacion-de-entrenamientos-en-canch.longDescription: A court session structure ready to apply with your group, designed for coaches who need to organize their week.

plan-de-gimnasio-para-mejorar-el-salto.title: PRO gym plan
plan-de-gimnasio-para-mejorar-el-salto.shortDescription: Gym routine focused on jump power and injury prevention.
plan-de-gimnasio-para-mejorar-el-salto.longDescription: A gym routine focused on jump power and injury prevention, to complement court work.

plan-aerobico-pro.title: PRO aerobic plan
plan-aerobico-pro.shortDescription: Aerobic base to sustain match pace on the sand.
plan-aerobico-pro.longDescription: An aerobic base designed specifically to sustain the match pace demanded by playing on sand.

todos-los-cursos.title: All courses
todos-los-cursos.shortDescription: The club's 8 technical courses in a single bundle, with a volume discount.
todos-los-cursos.longDescription: The club's 8 technical courses — attack, defense, blocking, setting, serve, reception, general concepts and mindset — in a single bundle, with a volume discount.

combo-k1-recepcion-armado-ataque.title: Bundle K1 — Reception, Setting, Attack
combo-k1-recepcion-armado-ataque.shortDescription: The 3 fundamentals of ball technique in a single bundle.
combo-k1-recepcion-armado-ataque.longDescription: Reception, setting and attack — the three fundamentals that build the play with the ball — combined in a single bundle.

combo-k2-saque-defensa-bloqueo.title: Bundle K2 — Serve, Defense, Blocking

combo-k2-saque-defensa-bloqueo.longDescription: Serve, defense and blocking — the three fundamentals that sustain the point from the defensive side — combined in a single bundle.
